title: deactivate run at startup missing in settings

judgment.rationale: The source snapshot already contains a General > Startup toggle. The reported version string (0.13.13096.0) does not identify a current build, so the claim cannot yet be tied to a missing control in the current UI.
evidence: The reporter says the option to disable startup is missing in Settings > General.
The report lists version 0.13.13096.0 and has an unanswered maintainer /needinfo request.
The issue discussion contains an outstanding /needinfo request and no follow-up identifying the build or showing the missing control.

The current General page includes a Run at Startup SettingsCard with a two-way ToggleSwitch. Source at pinned main (237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c): https://github.com/microsoft/PowerToys/blob/237dc893c8c76b1bfa65994afda41ea7315a914c/src/settings-ui/Settings.UI/SettingsXAML/Views/GeneralPage.xaml

fix_assessment.rationale: No code change is justified for a control that exists in the pinned current Settings UI; first establish the exact build, page, and whether policy disables it.

comment.body: Thanks for reporting that the startup option is missing. The issue lists version 0.13.13096.0, while the current PowerToys Settings source includes a Run at Startup toggle on General. Could you attach a screenshot of the General page around the Startup section and confirm the exact PowerToys version shown under About? This will distinguish a missing control from a different setting or a policy-disabled toggle.
